小火焰猴是一只似猴子的宝可梦。其色彩以橙色为主，而脸孔、外耳、腹下、手掌及脚掌则以浅黄色为主色调。小火焰猴背面的火焰而由燃烧胃内的气体而产生的。与小火龙不同，小火焰猴背部的火焰并不会在雨中熄灭，但却会在睡眠的时候熄灭。由于背部火焰的缘故，小火焰猴背上，一个细小且呈红色的圆块是难以引人注目的。再者，与头的大小相比下，小火焰猴有一双大耳朵，其内而红色的。小火焰猴的眼睛上方及外面有红色的花纹，而在其胸口上则有一个漩涡状的标记。小火焰猴每只手上有五根手指，而每只脚掌上则有三根脚趾。
小火焰猴是十分稀有的。它们只会在悬崖边及由岩石建成的山上居住。
小火焰猴懂得数种火属性的招式，如火花、火焰轮。小火焰猴也可以学习一些格斗属性及恶属性的招式，如劈瓦、真空波、诡计及挑衅等，也许这与它的进化形带有格斗属性有关。虽然小火焰猴是火属性宝可梦，但它也可以学习打草结这一类草属性的招式。
与真实的猿猴相似，小火焰猴十分好奇且淘气。但在逼迫之下，小火焰猴可以变得很勇敢。由于它们动作悠游自如，小火焰猴可以轻而易举地攀上它们的栖所－高山与悬崖峭壁。虽然小火焰猴的设计意念是源于猿猴，但小火焰猴的叫声是比较似蜘蛛猿。当小火焰猴感到不适时，其背部的火焰会变得较弱。

segments.text: One of Id's former blood servants and a Second (vampire turned from human by a First/Shinso) who has been alive for the better part of four hundred years. She was originally an Irish (indications are she was from Dublin) pub waitress. She is sent to mentor and assess Jun for his potential as a successor to his grandfather shortly after the story begins. She holds a number of roles in the story, as mentor, mother, sister, and lover, and she carries them out with aplomb. She can be extremely cold and ruthless with those outside her family, and even with those inside the family, she is quietly strict while looking after them at all times. She really does love Jun from the very start, and she never lies to him, though she doesn't tell him everything. Her Moon Ties ability, Dead Copy, allows her to break down objects on the particulate level and reconstitute them into various shapes and substances she has 'recorded'. This can be applied to anything from making food out of random materials to replacing lost limbs and organs. However, the appearance is always changed, if slightly.

Her first love and lover was Id, who treated her as a replacement for his own mother, giving her an insane amount of experience playing the role. His act of abandoning her when he tried to elope with Yukari broke her heart and her loyalty to him completely beyond repair, though she still cares for him.
